committee: *Presentation of Resolution No. 139-38 (LS) - Senator Tina Rose Muña-Barnes
location: Residence of Mayor Richard Arroyo in Agana Heights
title: Buenas yan Håfa Adai! Please join me in presenting Resolution No . 139 - 38 (LS) - Tina Rose Muña-Barnes, V. Anthony Ada, Jesse A. Lujan, Joe S. San Agustin - “Relative to recognizing the Honorable Carl T.C. Gutierrez, former Governor of Guam, for his service and contributions to Guam and the Asia-Pacific region; and congratulating him as the recipient of “The Order of The Rising Sun, Gold Rays With Neck Ribbon” from the Government of Japan. ” Presentation will be held on Wednesday, January 28, 2026 at 6pm at the residence of Governor Carl T.C.
